text:
maria: GH Actions run https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/actions/runs/123456789 keeps failing on the upload-artifact step — proxy returning 503 which causes terraform apply to abort because plan cache is missing. Anyone else seeing spikes?

ashok: I see 3/5 runs in the last hour with the same 503. Looks like artifact-proxy in us-west1 is throttling.

olivia: logs: `PUT /_apis/artifact` -> 503, header `x-proxy-retry-after: 1`. Also a few `connection reset by peer`.

seth: This is blocking the canary smoke. Can we short-circuit by reusing the last successful plan from the repo?

infra-bot: incident INC-3912 created for artifact-proxy 503 spikes in us-west1.

maria: Quick workaround: I re-ran the workflow with ARTIFACT_UPLOAD=false and pushed the plan from my workspace; smoke deploy passed. Not ideal for CI though. :facepalm:

ashok: Hypothesis: concurrency on GH Actions allows multiple runners to upload the same artifact key at once -> proxy overload. We should add retries with backoff + jitter and avoid identical artifact keys.

olivia: Could also serialize the deploys with `concurrency: group: infra-${{ github.ref }}` to avoid parallel uploads for the same branch. But that will throttle merges.

seth: Slowing merges is rough. Alternate: make upload nonblocking: if artifact upload fails, fall back to pushing plan to S3 with a run-id and continue. Also log response headers so we can quantify backpressure.

maria: I'll open a quick PR to add retries and unique artifact names (include run id). Draft of the fail-loop I tested locally:

```yaml
- name: upload plan with retry
  run: |
    RETRIES=5
    for i in $(seq 1 $RETRIES); do
      echo "attempt $i: uploading plan"
      gh api repos/:owner/:repo/actions/artifacts --input plan.tf && break || (sleep $((2**i)) && echo "retrying...")
    done
```

ashok: +1 for retries + unique keys. Also add a small jitter to backoff so concurrent runners don't sync.

olivia: I'll check the artifact-proxy pods — look for OOMs or restart loops, and check nginx error logs for 502/503 flood. Pinging @oncall to raise replicas if needed.

oncall: seeing increased 5xxs from proxy, bumping replicas by 2 in us-west1 for now. Will monitor.

seth: We should also add circuit-breaker in the workflow: if upload fails X times, mark the build as flaky and auto-fall back to last-known-plan. That keeps customers unblocked.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/802 — adds exponential backoff + run-id artifact names + fallback to S3. Will watch runs for the next hour.

ashok: thanks. once this is in, let's also add telemetry on artifact-proxy rates and per-repo byte/s so we can set proper autoscaling. :thumbsup:

olivia: noted — adding dashboard ticket to track artifact 5xxs and request rates.

maria: marking this thread resolved for now, will update if we see new failures.
